proposition.claim:
Recorded check: The auxiliary lower bound and finite critical points require qualifications

IID real environment with all absolute exponential moments; nearest-neighbor simple random walk. d >= 3; weak disorder; nonzero continuous compactly supported test f. Theorem 1.4 explicitly drops upper-boundedness and beta > beta_L2; beta=0 remains permitted.

Recorded check: Gaussian covariance is inconsistent with nearest-neighbor normalization

Nearest-neighbor simple random walk on Z^d, d>=3. Endpoint scaled by sqrt(n); phi explicitly called standard normal. At beta=0 the bounded continuous test f(x)=cos(x_1) is admissible.

Recorded check: The fractional-moment domain in Proposition 2.1 is overstated

p in (0,1) explicitly included in proof. IID weights with all exponential moments; section not restricted to weak disorder. Counterexample d=1, standard Gaussian weights, beta=4, p=1/2.

Recorded check: The general lower-bound proof needs a moment replacement and local sign/geometry corrections

d>=3; weak disorder; general nonzero signed f in C_c. The general lower-bound theorem does not assume p*>1, whereas the proof chooses p in (1,p*). Independent time layers; ell_n=o(sqrt(n)); uniform CLT good-event probabilities over the required window.

Recorded check: The moment-growth exponent and renewal coordinates are incorrect as displayed

Weak disorder beyond L2 with upper-bounded weights; 1<p*<2. 0<eta<1; alpha>1; stopping times in Lemma 4.7. Doob exponent must lie strictly between 1 and p*.

Recorded check: Upper bounds and overlap moments require normalized constants

omega<=K, K>0; normalized eta=exp(beta omega-lambda(beta)). No centering or lambda(beta)>=0 assumption. For the full-range witness start from any nondegenerate admissible main-theorem model and shift by its upper bound.

repair.content:
Require nonconstant normalized eta for the nontrivial lower bound. Then q* is finite by a favorable finite-box event and killed-walk spectral radius. Permit extended critical values and qualify finite strict-gap assertions.

Use phi_d=(d/(2pi))^(d/2)exp(-d|x|^2/2), or consistently rescale the walk. Reselect z with f*phi_d(z) nonzero; the Gaussian Fourier transform gives existence.

Restrict nonnegative bounds and monotonicity to p>=1; give reversed fractional bounds separately.

Use UI or explicitly justify p*>1; use bad event A^c in Holder; use |Zhat|. Use xi_q until p*=q*, probability >3/4 before (35), C(1+n^((1-delta)/2)/ell_n)^d grid count, E_n subset Ehat_n, constants covering E|eta-1| and E[eta|eta-1|], full chosen-site indicator/translated block in the density, and heat kernel C(Delta t)^(-d/2)exp(-c|Delta x|^2/Delta t).

Set L=max(1,2p*/(2+eta)), lambda=(p*+L)/2 and delta=[lambda(2+eta)-2p*]/2>0; bound the joint stopping event and union over levels. In Theorem 1.5 choose eta=min(epsilon/[2(p*+epsilon+1)],(p*-1)/2), retain gain alpha^(2k-l-1), and define cumulative sigma_{i+1}=sigma_i+sigma shifted and Z_{i+1}=Z_i+Z shifted. Fresh time layers then give the required exponential moment base.

Set alpha=2M; lower increments are bounded by -1, sufficient for the exponential supermartingale. Replace appendix e^(beta K) by M, obtaining adequate tail constant (1/2)M^-p*. Retain walk probability in A(x)=(1/(2d))sum eta^2; moments finite under (1).
